raw.details:
Overview:

2 Problems. Solve Both. Beat the Clock.

CodeSprint is an online coding challenge organised by RANKUP for participants who want to test their programming, problem-solving, logical thinking, and coding skills through real coding problems.

Challenge Format:

  • 2 coding problems
  • Both problems are mandatory
  • Limited time to complete the challenge
  • Actual code submission and execution
  • Multiple programming languages supported
  • Individual participation
  • Online mode
  • Automated evaluation through test cases

Programming Languages:

Participants can use supported programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript, and other languages available on the competition platform.

How It Works:

  • Register for CodeSprint
  • Access the coding challenge during the scheduled contest window
  • Attempt both programming problems
  • Submit your solutions through the coding environment
  • Solutions are automatically evaluated using test cases
  • Rankings are determined based on coding performance and successful problem solutions

Rewards & Recognition:

Top 10 Performers:

  • 1 free .xyz domain for each Top 10 performer, with the first year free
  • Certificate of Achievement

All Other Participants:

  • Certificate of Participation

Important:

Both coding problems are mandatory. Participants should attempt and submit solutions for both problems within the allotted contest time.

Organised by RANKUP

Your Skills. Your Rank. Your Journey.

prizes.others: top 10 performers will receive 1 free .xyz domain for one year along with a Certificate of Achievement.
